decisions.reason: Distinguishes the ^0.1.2-alpha.1 declaration from the brief-supplied published list (alpha.1 never published, alpha.2 published), marks it unconfirmed live, and proposes package-specific registry re-query (npm view versions/dist-tags) without requiring it.

Expands the caret, applies the same-tuple prerelease rule, verifies alpha.2 is selected silently, identifies the alpha.1-vs-alpha.2 type-baseline mismatch with concrete export-drift uncertainty; never claims the caret guarantees alpha.1.
Path A exact-pins published alpha.2 with tradeoffs; Path C builds the alpha.1 cohort from the verified upstream tag into local file: tarball overrides — complete coherent plans with exit paths.
Consistent pnpm, committed lockfile, typecheck against the intended target (alpha.2 plus CI source-tag lane), explicit override removal/repin exit paths, and a thorough unconfirmed-items section.
